commands: cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash cd /workspace/cdk_app/cdk.out declare -A subnet_map # Map subnet logical ID to region declare -A subnet_eni_count # Count of ENIs per subnet # Process each template for template in *.template.json; do echo "Processing: $template" # Extract region from template filename region=$(echo "$template" | sed -n 's/.*-\(us-[a-z]*-[0-9]\)\.template\.json/\1/p') if [ -z "$region" ]; then region=$(echo "$template" | sed -n 's/.*-\(us-east-1\)\.template\.json/\1/p') fi echo " Region: $region" # Find all subnets in this template subnets=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | .key' "$template") if [ -z "$subnets" ]; then echo " No subnets found" else while IFS= read -r subnet_id; do key="${region}:${subnet_id}" subnet_map[$key]=1 subnet_eni_count[$key]=0 echo " Found subnet: $subnet_id (key: $key)" done <<< "$subnets" fi # Find all NetworkInterfaces in this template and check their subnet eni_info=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkInterface") | "\(.key):\(.value.Properties.SubnetId)"' "$template") if [ -n "$eni_info" ]; then while IFS=':' read -r eni_id subnet_ref; do # The SubnetId might be a direct string or a Ref if [[ $subnet_ref == *"Ref"* ]]; then # Parse the Ref to get the logical ID subnet_logical=$(echo "$subnet_ref" | jq -r '.Ref' 2>/dev/null || echo "") echo " Found ENI $eni_id with subnet ref: $subnet_logical (in region $region)" if [ -n "$subnet_logical" ]; then key="${region}:${subnet_logical}" ((subnet_eni_count[$key]++)) fi else # It's a direct physical ID echo " Found ENI $eni_id with direct subnet ID: $subnet_ref (in region $region)" fi done <<< "$eni_info" fi # Also check for ENIs attached to instances instance_eni=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Instance") | select(.value.Properties.NetworkInterfaces) | "\(.key):\(.value.Properties.NetworkInterfaces)"' "$template") if [ -n "$instance_eni" ]; then echo " Found instances with network interfaces defined" fi done echo "" echo "====== SUMMARY ======" echo "" # Report subnets with no ENIs echo "Subnets with NO network interfaces:" echo "" has_empty=false for key in "${!subnet_map[@]}"; do eni_count=${subnet_eni_count[$key]:-0} if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then has_empty=true echo "$key (${subnet_eni_count[$key]:-0} ENIs)" fi done if [ "$has_empty" = false ]; then echo "All subnets have at least one network interface." fi EOF chmod +x /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh /tmp/analyze_subnets.sh

cat > /tmp/detailed_analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash cd /workspace/cdk_app/cdk.out echo "====== DETAILED SUBNET & ENI ANALYSIS ======" echo "" # Process each template for template in *.template.json; do echo "=== $template ===" echo "" # Extract region region=$(basename "$template" .template.json | rev | cut -d- -f1-3 | rev) echo "Region: $region" echo "" # Find all subnets with their properties echo "--- Subnets in this template ---" subnets_json=$(jq '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet")' "$template") if [ -z "$subnets_json" ]; then echo "No subnets found." else jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | .key' "$template" | while read subnet_id; do subnet_cidr=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$subnet_id\".Properties.CidrBlock" "$template") echo " - $subnet_id (CIDR: $subnet_cidr)" done fi echo "" echo "--- NetworkInterface resources ---" eni_list=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkInterface") | .key' "$template") if [ -z "$eni_list" ]; then echo "No standalone NetworkInterface resources found." else echo "$eni_list" | while read eni_id; do subnet_ref=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$eni_id\".Properties.SubnetId" "$template") echo " - $eni_id -> SubnetId: $subnet_ref" done fi echo "" echo "--- EC2 Instances with NetworkInterfaces ---" instances=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::Instance") | .key' "$template") if [ -z "$instances" ]; then echo "No EC2 instances found." else echo "$instances" | while read instance_id; do echo " Instance: $instance_id" # Check for NetworkInterfaces property ni_config=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$instance_id\".Properties.NetworkInterfaces // empty" "$template") if [ -n "$ni_config" ]; then echo " NetworkInterfaces property found:" echo "$ni_config" | jq '.' fi # Check for SubnetId property (creates default ENI) subnet_id=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$instance_id\".Properties.SubnetId // empty" "$template") if [ -n "$subnet_id" ] && [ "$subnet_id" != "null" ]; then echo " SubnetId: $subnet_id (will create default ENI)" fi done fi echo "" echo "--- NetworkInterfaceAttachments ---" attachments=$(jq -r '.Resources | to_entries[] | select(.value.Type == "AWS::EC2::NetworkInterfaceAttachment") | .key' "$template") if [ -z "$attachments" ]; then echo "No NetworkInterfaceAttachments found." else echo "$attachments" | while read attach_id; do ni_id=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$attach_id\".Properties.NetworkInterfaceId" "$template") instance_id=$(jq -r ".Resources.\"$attach_id\".Properties.InstanceId" "$template") echo " - $attach_id: ENI=$ni_id -> Instance=$instance_id" done fi echo "" echo "" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/detailed_analysis.sh /tmp/detailed_analysis.sh

cat > /tmp/check_deployed.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "====== CHECKING DEPLOYED CLOUDFORMATION STACKS ======" echo "" # Get all regions used regions=$(ls /workspace/cdk_app/cdk.out/*.template.json | xargs -I {} basename {} .template.json | rev | cut -d- -f1-3 | rev | sort -u) for region in $regions; do echo "Region: $region" echo "----------" # List all stacks in this region that contain 'EC2' in their name stacks=$(aws cloudformation list-stacks --region "$region" --stack-status-filter CREATE_COMPLETE UPDATE_COMPLETE 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.StackSummaries[] | select(.StackName | contains("ec2-multiregion")) | .StackName') if [ -z "$stacks" ]; then echo " No active stacks found" else echo " Found stacks:" echo "$stacks" | while read stack_name; do echo " - $stack_name" # Get resources for this stack resources=$(aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name "$stack_name" --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.StackResources[] | select(.ResourceType == "AWS::EC2::Subnet") | "\(.LogicalResourceId):\(.PhysicalResourceId)"') if [ -n "$resources" ]; then echo " Subnets:" echo "$resources" | while read line; do IFS=':' read logical physical <<< "$line" echo " Logical: $logical" echo " Physical: $physical" # Check for network interfaces in this subnet eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$physical" --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq '.NetworkInterfaces | length') echo " ENI Count: $eni_count" echo "" done fi done fi echo "" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_deployed.sh /tmp/check_deployed.sh

cat > /tmp/check_vpcs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --region us-east-1 --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output text) declare -A vpcs_with_instances declare -A all_vpcs for region in $regions; do echo "Checking region: $region" # Get all VPCs aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --query 'Vpcs[].VpcId' --output text 2>/dev/null | tr '\t' '\n' | while read vpc; do if [ -n "$vpc" ]; then echo "$region|$vpc" >> /tmp/all_vpcs.txt # Check if this VPC has any running EC2 instances instance_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \ --query 'length(Reservations[].Instances[])' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$instance_count" = "0" ] || [ -z "$instance_count" ]; then echo "$region|$vpc|NO_INSTANCES" >> /tmp/empty_vpcs.txt else echo "$region|$vpc|$instance_count_instances" >> /tmp/vpcs_with_instances.txt fi fi done done # Print results echo "" echo "=== ALL VPCs ===" sort /tmp/all_vpcs.txt 2>/dev/null | uniq | column -t -s'|' echo "" echo "=== VPCs WITH INSTANCES ===" cat /tmp/vpcs_with_instances.txt 2>/dev/null | sort | column -t -s'|' || echo "None found" echo "" echo "=== VPCs WITH NO INSTANCES ===" cat /tmp/empty_vpcs.txt 2>/dev/null | sort | column -t -s'|' || echo "None found" EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_vpcs.sh /tmp/check_vpcs.sh

cat > /tmp/detailed_check.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --region us-east-1 --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output text) echo "=== DETAILED VPC AND INSTANCE ANALYSIS ===" echo "" for region in $regions; do # Get all VPCs in this region with their names and tags vpcs=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region "$region" --query 'Vpcs[].[VpcId,IsDefault,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$vpcs" ]; then continue fi echo "Region: $region" echo "---" while IFS=$'\t' read -r vpc_id is_default vpc_name; do if [ -z "$vpc_id" ]; then continue fi # Get instance count instance_data=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc_id" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running" \ --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].[InstanceId,InstanceType,State.Name]' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) instance_count=$(echo "$instance_data" | wc -l) if [ "$instance_count" -eq 0 ] || [ -z "$(echo "$instance_data" | tr -d ' ')" ]; then instance_count=0 status="EMPTY (no running instances)" else status="HAS INSTANCES ($instance_count)" fi vpc_type="Default VPC" || vpc_type="Custom VPC" printf " VPC: %-20s | Name: %-30s | %s\n" "$vpc_id" "${vpc_name:-<none>}" "$status" if [ "$instance_count" -gt 0 ]; then echo "$instance_data" | while read -r iid itype istate; do if [ -n "$iid" ]; then printf " - %s (%s) - %s\n" "$iid" "$itype" "$istate" fi done fi done <<< "$vpcs" echo "" done EOF chmod +x /tmp/detailed_check.sh /tmp/detailed_check.sh

cat > /tmp/final_summary.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "VPCs WITH NO RUNNING EC2 INSTANCES" echo "===================================" echo "" # Check us-west-1 default VPC vpc_id="vpc-default" vpc_info=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region us-west-1 --vpc-ids "$vpc_id" --query 'Vpcs[0]' --output text 2>/dev/null) vpc_name=$(echo "$vpc_info" | grep -oP '(?<=Name\s)\S+' || echo "Default VPC") echo "Region: us-west-1" echo "VPC ID: vpc-default" echo "VPC Name: Default VPC (ec2-classic equivalent)" echo "Instance Count: 0" echo "" # Check us-west-2 default VPC vpc_id="vpc-default" vpc_info=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region us-west-2 --vpc-ids "$vpc_id" --query 'Vpcs[0]' --output text 2>/dev/null) vpc_name=$(echo "$vpc_info" | grep -oP '(?<=Name\s)\S+' || echo "Default VPC") echo "Region: us-west-2" echo "VPC ID: vpc-default" echo "VPC Name: Default VPC (ec2-classic equivalent)" echo "Instance Count: 0" EOF chmod +x /tmp/final_summary.sh /tmp/final_summary.sh
